name: TRON

key_findings: Three Partial gates and no outright Pass on any TradFi gate.

The Regulatory Clarity cap (65) no longer binds: raw 63.35 falls below it, so the published score is the raw. Pending post-quantum mainnet activation would now move the published score, where previously it could not.
On-Chain Health (88) is TRON's strongest category -- roughly $2 trillion in cumulative USDT transfers in one quarter, backed by real fee revenue rather than a running subsidy.

Regulatory & Risk (48) cuts both ways on one root cause -- TRON carries a high volume of frozen and blacklisted addresses, but the entity doing that freezing was cited by FATF as a model for public-private enforcement.

Privacy & Confidentiality (40) sits at the transparent floor despite a native protocol-level zk-SNARK shielded TRC-20 pool verified enabled on mainnet. No mainstream wallet exposes it, public RPC nodes frequently return 405 on the shielded-transaction endpoint, and there is no published usage data. The anonymity set is the product, and there is no evidence of one.
No binding cap -- Deterministic Finality Partial (75) sits above the raw 67.1. TRON has no dated upgrade planned to fix its ~1 minute finality.
Privacy & Confidentiality (53) -- live shielded transfers using zero-knowledge proofs, but adoption is unmeasured and does not touch the USDT flow that is effectively the entire chain.

Agent Tooling (68) -- a real, shipped agent stack (Bank of AI: payments, identity, an MCP server) launched February 2026, discounted for being six months old, single-vendor, and running on a gas subsidy.
Both axes validated in opposite directions under blind secondary review -- TradFi scores moved down, AI scores moved up.

watch_items: TRON ETF eligibility clock started July 27, 2026 with Bitnomial's CFTC-regulated TRX futures listing -- six-month generic-listing-standard milestone matures around late January 2027.
Post-quantum work (Falcon-512 and ML-DSA-44 live on Nile testnet) is real but early. With no cap binding, mainnet activation would now move the published TradFi score.
Any measurable adoption of the shielded TRC-20 pool, or wallet-level exposure of it, would be a re-credit candidate for Privacy & Confidentiality.
